title: Karbala Sey Jo Kabhi Ho Kay Hawaa Aati Hai
body:
Karbala sey jo kabhi ho kay hawaa aati hai
Kisi maasoom ki hichkee ki sadaa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan dhadakta na ho marqad mein kahin qalb-e-rabab
Ali Asghar, Ali Asghar ki sadaa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa samajtee hai dulhan laaoongi aaya hai shabaab
Sheh samajtey hain kay Akbar ki qazaa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Koyi beemaar na paddtaa ho tahajjud ki namaaz
Raat mein beydiyon ki kyun yeh sadaa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaid khaaney mein qayamat sey siwaa aathaa hai din
Raat kya aati hai ek aur balaa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Munh phira leytay hain Abbas tapak padtey hain ashk
Nehr ki simth sey thandee jo hawaa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaun sothaa hai kanaarey teray aye nehr-e-furaat
Teri mitthi sey abhi boo-eywafaa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab ziyaada kabhi beemaar main hotha hoon shaheed
Khud ba khud meray liye khaak-e-shifaa aati hai
